objective: Install the built HolyAgent extension file into Pi dist, using a working PR branch if one contains it, and verify the installed result.
requirements: Install the built extension file in pi dist.
There might be a PR branch that is working; use gh to find and use it.
Use the requested kimi-for-coding model through the registered Pi provider ID kimi-coding for delegated Pi runs.
Do not replace or remove unrelated files, including the existing untracked packages/integrations/pi/dist/extensions/.pi/ path, without establishing ownership.
